title: Veronese section fractions present homogeneous localization
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $L$ be an invertible module [def-sc-invertible-module], and let $S=\bigoplus_{i\geq0}\Gamma(X,L^{\otimes i})$ be its graded section ring [def-sc-invertible-section-ring]. Let $d\in\mathbf N$ and $s\in S_d$. Set $M=L^{\otimes d}$ and write $\sigma=s_d\in\Gamma(X,M)$. Let $Q$ be the section-fraction presentation [def-sc-section-fraction-presentation] for $M$, $\mathcal O_X$, and $\sigma$: its numerator in degree $n$ is a section of $\mathcal O_X\otimes M^{\otimes n}$. There exists an additive equivalence $e:S_{(s)}\simeq Q$ such that, for every $n\geq0$ and $\xi\in S_{nd}$, $e(\xi/s^n)=[n,T_n(\xi_{nd})]$. Here $S_{(s)}$ is the degree-zero homogeneous localization at the powers of $s$, and $T_n:L^{\otimes nd}\simeq\mathcal O_X\otimes M^{\otimes n}$ is the composite of the exponent equality $nd=dn$, the canonical tensor-power multiplication isomorphism, and the inverse left unitor. No compactness or positive-degree hypothesis is imposed.

theorem exists_sectionRing_veronese_fraction_equiv
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (d : ℕ) (s : sectionRingGrade L d) :
    ∃ e : HomogeneousLocalization.Away (sectionRingGrade L) s.val ≃+
        SectionFractionPresentation (L.tensorPow d) (𝟙_ X.Modules) (s.val d),
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (ξ : sectionRingGrade L (n • d)),
        e (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (sectionRingGrade L) s.property n
          ξ.val ξ.property) =
        sectionFraction (L.tensorPow d) (𝟙_ X.Modules) (s.val d) n
          ((eqToIso (congrArg L.tensorPow (by simp [Nat.mul_comm])) ≪≫
            L.tensorPowMulIso d n ≪≫ (λ_ _).symm).hom.app ⊤ (ξ.val (n • d)))
